scope: Unify explicit bounded doctor model-access interface and legacy adapter; fake transport only. No new provider call is authorized.

cli.offline: Existing flags, results and invalid bare --live behavior preserved.
cli.parsing: Reject unknown, duplicate, ambiguous and incomplete options before selected env/key access. No argv echo.
cli.allocationFile: Maximum16KiB, fatal UTF8, strict flat JSON with duplicate/unknown keys refused; regular non-symlink file inside selected real workspace. Reject equality with selected env path before opening the allocation.

allocation.envFile: normalized workspace-relative selected env file (default .env), or null for process
allocation.model: bounded identifier matching exact selected effective model
allocation.expiresAt: strict UTC ISO timestamp, future and at most30minutes from admission

authority: Declared operator scope only; does not establish ownership, signature, cross-process single-use or a global spend ledger. Reuse across invocations requires actual owner authorization outside the code. No provider request is allocated by this task.

api.live: runAllocatedAiReadiness(input,allocationUnknown,dependencies?) validates scope before effective-config resolution. Optional third runAiDoctor dependencies for fake fetch/clock/signal only.
api.legacy: Export runLiveOpenAiModel(argv,environment,deps), import-safe direct-entry guard and delegate to doctor. Explicit --live passed unchanged; otherwise prepend it; --help forwards help. Noargs refuses as bare --live.

configuration: Resolve selected file/Node.parseEnv/inherited precedence exactly once, privately, shared with offline resolver. Never fall back to getAnalysisConfig or SDK ambient context. Preserve existing safe offline report fields/flags/precedence and every prior assertion.

transport.sdk: Actual installed OpenAI6.47.0 models.retrieve only; no generation/list/fallback.
transport.request: One exact HTTPS api.openai.com/v1/models/<encoded selected model> GET with no body; count before dispatch; zero retries or redirects.
transport.context: Explicit selected key/base/org/project, null absent org/project/adminKey/webhookSecret; logging off and silent logger; exclude ambient custom headers. Never return secrets.
transport.limits: AbortController deadline min(timeoutMs,expiry-now), caller cancellation supported, response bytes capped64KiB and reading/parsing inside deadline. Honor SDK signal, redirect:error and one-dispatch guard.
transport.result: Only a valid model response correlated to requested model can prove this model access; no writing/generation/product readiness claim.

output.fields: Fixed safe status/authentication/failure enums, allocationAccepted, providerRequests0|1,generationRequests0,retries0,redirects0,httpStatus bounded|null,deadlineAborted. No actual model/base/context/key identifiers, paths, argv, messages, bodies, headers or stacks.
output.exit: 2 arguments/allocation refusal;1 failed/unavailable;0 successful allocated model access only. Offline schema remains unchanged.

acceptance: Actual existing doctor RED for complete allocated-live arguments, not missing import.
One real-SDK/fake-fetch success with exact request/context/counters.
Invalid/incomplete/duplicate/expired/mismatched allocation or config refuses without dispatch; admission failures do not access selected env/key.
401/429/503/network failures do not retry or expose canaries.
Deadline/caller abort, redirect and oversized/malformed/mismatched response controls.
Import-safe legacy script and actual delegation; all existing offline assertions unchanged.

owners.reviewer: Read-only compatibility/transport review in runtime worktree; no source ownership.
owners.root: Contract, dependencies, integration, plans/runbook/context and one final affected gate.

boundaries: No real env/keys/provider request, SQL parse/execution, database/browser/services/Docker, dependencies, Git or deployment. Source and fake transport only. Separate worktrees and finite affected checks.
